executed_checks.detail: Parsed 15 relevant public Python sources plus the private transport script; no third-party import or NN execution.

All 152 initialization labels and 704 retained phrases match confirmed_category plus the first four stable_attributes from the human-confirmed CSV. Omitted attributes, IDs, sequences, frame IDs, reviewers, status and review round also agree.
The 3502-row persisted GT labels match preparation/download digests. All partitions match 130 fit/22 development human-label sequences; valid-GT key sets are exactly 2544 fit/495 development.

Recounted all eight event files, every saved subgroup summary, both launch arrays, all six zero exit files, both three-step sanity and both 480-step final receipts. All inspected M113 artifacts match M113_DOCUMENT_SYNC digests; current M113 trainer matches result source_sha256.
Actual native-poor/oracle-good events prove at least 68 fit and 16 development states contain both IoU classes, so full-split margins are nonempty without speculative fallback.

Actual analyzer functions passed hand-built checks: BCE at zero and +/-1000, pure common shift, candidate-specific shift, margin crossing, absent-class counters, energy identity, and independent log1p(exp(score))-target*score BCE. These are synthetic arithmetic checks, not model evidence.
Reread corrected diagnostic/controller and reviewed analyzer, input/model path and exact private deployment source. Final hashes are recorded.

source_assessment.zero_update: Strict checkpoint load, requires_grad_(False), eval/no_grad. No optimizer, backward, checkpoint write, training, seed search or automatic promotion. Constructor randomness is overwritten by strict state_dict loading; current attention modules have no active dropout.
source_assessment.GT_boundary: load_inputs computes candidate IoUs against persisted dataset GT boxes. batch explicitly excludes iou from model tensors; key/strata remain outside model inputs. M110/M107 helpers reuse human text tokens/masks without invoking their training main functions.
source_assessment.conditions_and_invariants: Empty/object/human_text use the same final and visual candidates. Empty selection equals visual exactly and semantic/phrase deltas equal zero. Quality must equal the same-batch Empty result for each condition. Selection/quality/semantic/phrase outputs must be finite. Every parameter and registered buffer equals the loaded state, and checkpoint bytes retain their digest.
source_assessment.replay_scope: Per arm: sanity is 64 fit+64 development states, 384 condition rows and 256 stored comparisons. Full is 2544+495 states, 9117 rows and 4029 stored comparisons: own-arm fit only, all three development conditions. No unavailable fit cross-condition scores are claimed.
source_assessment.controller: GPU0 human final/GPU1 generic final. Both sanity exits and status, zero-step, replay-scope, state-count, Empty/quality/weight gates must pass before full starts. Failure preserves logs without retry. Pair completion and driver.exit=0 appear only after full succeeds; analyzer requires both.
source_assessment.arithmetic: Per-state common delta is sum(scores-empty)/K. Common energy is K*common^2; candidate-specific energy is sum((delta-common)^2). BCE averages all candidate GT-IoU targets. Margin=max(score at IoU>=0.5)-max(score at IoU<=0.1), with missing classes counted separately. Python first-maximum selection matches torch.argmax.
source_assessment.transport: Only the supplied authorized endpoint at port43811; password from stdin. Checks accepted local review digests and its own exact digest, M113 terminal status and zero exit, absent M114 outputs/private directory, two idle GPUs (<100MiB,0% utilization), and disk space. Checks seven reused remote helpers and all uploaded bytes, preserves additive master content and starts exactly the reviewed controller. No install, new training, deletion, credential-file read or old-job termination.
source_assessment.scientific_scope: Train fixed-state diagnostic only. Common score shifts/BCE changes are not physical-identity evidence. Low IoU means poor localization, not different-instance truth. No recursive tracker commit, official evaluation or nine-metric goal completion.

limitations: No SSH, credentials access, remote resource probe, GPU/NN execution, deployment, or experiment source/data mutation was performed by this reviewer.

M113 checkpoint and bank digests agree across actual saved receipts; local weight/bank bytes were unavailable and were not rehashed. Reviewed M114 runtime must validate those bytes and execute numerical replay.
Persisted GT-label hash and preparation lineage were checked; raw dataset groundtruth files and remote feature tensors were not reread locally.
Analyzer function tests use synthetic arrays. Actual M114 response energies, BCE, margins and GPU replay results are not claimed.
Same-family fresh-context acceptance is provisional, not cross-family validation. Nine official metrics remain outstanding.
